transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, hi doctor. I'm here because... well, people keep acting like I'm just imagining it, but I'm not. I know for a fact that the hospital people and some folks from the agency have been watching our house. They even watch me on my cleaning routes at work. They're trying to see if I'm taking proper care of my husband. I just... I know what I see, even if no one else believes me.
When you think about people watching you, do you ever have any doubt about whether it's really happening, or are you completely certain that it's definitely occurring?

No, I don't have any doubt. I'm completely certain it's happening. Like I said, I know what I see. When I'm out doing my cleaning routes, or when I'm at home, I know the hospital and the agency people are there. They want to see if I'm taking care of my husband right. Everyone else might think I'm imagining it, but I know for a fact that they're watching us.
Over the past few weeks, how has your mood been? Have you been feeling depressed, sad, or down most of the time, or have you been feeling unusually energetic or irritable?

Well, I wouldn't say I've been depressed or sad. Honestly, there are these stretches lately where I feel... just really bright and strong. Like I have all the energy in the world and I can handle absolutely everything. 

But at the same time... well, I have been getting pretty irritable, too. If my husband questions me about something, or if one of my cleaning clients says something about my work, I just snap. I end up snapping at them much harder than I actually mean to. So I guess I've been feeling really capable and energetic, but definitely on edge.
When did you first start noticing that people were watching you and the hospital and agency were monitoring you—was this something that started recently, or has it been going on for a longer time?
It's not a recent thing, no. It's been going on for a longer time. Um, I'd say the feeling that people are watching us... and, well, the voices too... it's all been happening for about 11 months now.
Over these 11 months, has there been any time when the watching and the voices went away or stopped completely, even for a few weeks, or have they been pretty much continuous the whole time?

Well, they haven't stopped completely, no. There was... I guess a quieter spell, maybe a few months back. It lasted for a few weeks. I was sleeping a lot more during that time, just feeling really tired and not rushing around cleaning as much. 

But even then, it didn't go away. I still heard that voice over by the kitchen window, clear as day. And I still knew the agency was keeping an eye on us. So, it might have been a little quieter for a bit, but it's never really stopped.

During that quieter spell a few months ago when you were sleeping more and things were less intense—during that time, did your mood feel more normal, like your usual self? Or were you still feeling that bright energy and irritability even then?

My mood was mostly just normal then, yeah. I didn't have all that bright energy, and I wasn't snapping at people either. I was just tired. Like I mentioned, I was sleeping a lot more and just... not rushing around cleaning as much as I do now. 

But even though my mood felt pretty regular for those several weeks, the other things didn't stop. That's why I brought it up—even without all that energy, I still heard the voice by the kitchen window, and I still knew the agency was watching us. So the energy went away, but the rest of it stayed.
During those times when you've had the bright energy and irritability that you mentioned, were the voices and the feeling of being watched actually worse or more intense than they are now?

I don't know if I would say they were worse, exactly, but... they were definitely happening right along with the energy. 

During the weeks when I was sleeping very little, I was just running constantly. I'd go straight from my cleaning jobs to running church errands, just back and forth all day. And while I was doing all that rushing around, I was also hearing that woman's voice. Plus, I felt certain that people were monitoring my routes while I was out driving. So, yes, it was all going on at the exact same time.

When you think back to when this all first started 11 months ago, did you start hearing that woman's voice and feeling like people were watching you before you noticed the bright energy and irritability, or did the energy and irritability come first?

Let me think... the voices and the feeling of being watched definitely started first. Because I remember noticing all of that about 11 months ago. 

The other part—those stretches of being unusually energized, getting irritable, and barely sleeping at all—that's been happening on and off for about 10 months now. So, yeah, I was hearing the woman's voice and feeling like they were keeping an eye on me for maybe a month or so before all that bright energy actually started up.

Right now, at this moment, are you still hearing that woman's voice and still feeling certain that the agency is watching you—even though you're not in one of those periods where you have all that bright energy and irritability?

Right at this exact minute? No, I'm not hearing her. It's actually pretty quiet in here today. And I haven't really felt like anyone is watching me right now, either. I'm just sitting here talking to you, so... no, I haven't noticed any of that today.

Over these past 11 months, have there been other times besides that quieter spell—times when your mood felt normal and you weren't having that bright energy or irritability—but you were still hearing the woman's voice or still felt certain the agency was watching you?

Yes, there was. Um, I had a quieter spell for several weeks where my mood felt pretty normal. I was finally sleeping more, and I wasn't rushing around as much with my cleaning work. 

But even during those weeks, I still heard that woman's voice right by the kitchen window. And I still firmly believed that the agency was watching us. So, yes, even without all that extra energy, those things were still happening.

You mentioned that even during those weeks when your mood felt normal and you weren't having that bright energy, you still heard the woman's voice and believed the agency was watching. On the days right now when you're feeling normal—not energetic, not irritable—are you still hearing that woman's voice or still feeling like the agency is watching you?

Um, no, not lately. On the days right now where I just feel regular—like today, where I'm not all keyed up or cranky—I haven't heard her at all. And I haven't had that feeling about the agency watching me, either. It's just been... quiet, I guess. I haven't noticed any of it.
